name: claude-kit
description: Project-agnostic Claude Code plugins: architecture rubrics, a plan-review-implement pipeline with agent evals, QA skills, a project knowledge vault, and a paced queue for GitHub Projects boards.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Clean Architecture, SOLID and DDD rubrics for PHP (Symfony, Magento 2) and JavaScript/TypeScript, with an implementer's cut and stack references.

plugins.name: pipeline
plugins.description: Plan, review and implement features: the feature and bug-fix commands, the devils-advocate reviewer, the feature-contract-writer and feature-implementer agents, and an eval harness that regression-tests those agents.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Quality skills: bug-hunt walks a live site in a real browser and proves what breaks; tighten shortens text without losing meaning.

plugins.name: vault
plugins.description: A project knowledge vault kept beside the code: a session-start brief, session-end capture into an inbox, a check that holds the notes to the code, a search index, and the decision, journal, todo and wiki-sync commands with a wiki-updater agent.

plugins.name: board-queue
plugins.description: A durable queue and single writer for shared GitHub Projects boards: sessions and scripts file field changes, comments and closes; one scheduled worker per person applies them within the GraphQL allowance and reads every row back.
